WIN32_MODEL.doc: Shared Win32 GUI semantics with deterministic testing controls.

members.name: inject
members.doc: `inject (window, message)` queues a copied supported input event.

members.name: advance
members.doc: `advance milliseconds` advances mock time, or waits in a real driver.

members.name: trace
members.doc: `trace ()` returns the deterministic normalized operation trace.

members.name: reset
members.doc:
`reset ()` clears observations after every owned resource has closed.

**Raises** `Win32Common.Types.Error` while windows, classes, paints or owned GDI objects remain.
